records.rule: Alchemy Objects v0.8 preferred INIT:SUPER for service objects; semantics unchanged.
Rows, scalar values, geometry values, parser/expression nodes and other hot-path data remain lightweight.
FILE/Object/JSON/native SQLite/GeoPackage/Federated engines coexist behind relational boundaries.
Explicit relation projections only; no implicit recursive JSON flattening.
At complete v0.79 GitHub baseline, native ooRexx page-oriented SQLite/GeoPackage read-only engine; v0.89-v0.91 add a separate opt-in native-bridge SQLite writable candidate.
Federation builds neutral metadata from relation definition/capabilities; external providers need not construct NoSQLServer classes.
Resolve owning provider first; unsupported read-only mutation => SQLUNSUPPORTED, not NOTFOUND.
NOTEXECUTED and ROLLEDBACK are semantically different and must not be collapsed.
Use namespaced adapter; do not load overlapping complete public class sets into one package namespace.
CLASSIC is default; UNICODE requires explicit TUTOR enablement and fails closed when unavailable.
POINT/POLYGON accessors + strict WITHIN + boundary-inclusive INTERSECTS; no full Simple Features claim.
Access path is optimisation/evidence; complete SQL predicate/result semantics remain authoritative.
SQLPARSEERROR versus SQLUNSUPPORTED must remain explicit.

NoSQLServer owns SQL interpretation and engine selection; SQLite handles consistent backup snapshots and prepared atomic DML. Explicit opt-in; rollback-journal and WAL read/write, no implicit legacy upgrade.

Under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, compare current schema and every table row to the immutable selection snapshot before single-table UPDATE/DELETE, including zero-match. Abort the whole batch on conflict; not multi-table serializability.
Full database backup per SQL statement; O(table) conflict checking; no multi-statement transactional API, portable ABI certification, mesh shared-file lock authority or production soak.
PR #20 merged exact v0.91 patch intake; packages/nosqlserver_v0.79 remains the latest COMPLETE versioned NoSQLServer directory on main. Importing all v0.80-v0.91 source has not been completed.
